# Claude OAuth usage fixture provenance

`claude-oauth-usage.json` is a synthetic, contract-derived example, not an
authenticated capture. No live account behavior has been verified by this fixture.

OAuth wire fields were cross-checked against
[CodexBar's OAuth decoder](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/blob/d6c651ca26c4cd8fb886b5036275a3623b49d450/Sources/CodexBarCore/Providers/Claude/ClaudeOAuth/ClaudeOAuthUsageFetcher.swift).
